turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_shg_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`,
    `poscar` (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `shg` (the
    largest SHG tensor component |d_ij|, in pm/V).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the LARGEST SHG
tensor component |d_ij| (pm/V), then select the 5 best candidates from the
pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training set shows that the largest SHG responses arise in non-centrosymmetric tetrahedral (zincblende/chalcopyrite/wurtzite-derived) or Zintl-type structures that combine highly polarizable cations (Cd, In, Ga, Sn, Ge, Tl, Hg, Ta/Nb) with polarizable anions (Te > Se > As > P). Concrete high-value anchors include ZnIn3AsSe4 (55.7 pm/V), ZnSiP2 (51.4 pm/V), K14Nb2As8 (68.8 pm/V), GaP (61–69 pm/V) and Ba2Te6 (83 pm/V). Lattice parameters and site occupancies of the pool compounds were therefore matched to these anchors and the expected SHG scaled by the change in polarizability (Cd > Zn, Te > Se, As > P, Ta \(\approx\) Nb).

- c073 (CdIn3AsTe4) is the direct heavier analogue of ZnIn3AsSe4 (identical packing, expanded cell); the Cd/Te substitution produces the highest predicted response.
- c030 (CdSiP2) is the chalcopyrite analogue of ZnSiP2; Cd-for-Zn substitution (cf. CdSe vs ZnSe) raises the value into the 70 pm/V range.
- c090 (K14Ta2As8) is isostructural with K14Nb2As8 (cell edges agree to <0.3 %); Ta/Nb substitution leaves the response essentially unchanged (~70 pm/V).
- c079 (Ba4Ge2Te5Se3) inherits the polytelluride polarizability of Ba2Te6 together with additional Ge–Te/Se polar bonds.
- c055 (Al3Ga3As6) is a polar hexagonal superlattice of the GaP/GaAs family and therefore retains a large zincblende-type coefficient.

All other pool entries are either lighter-element analogues (lower polarizability), large-gap halides/oxides, or structures already represented in the training set by modest SHG values (<40 pm/V).

Final: c073, c030, c090, c079, c055
